args.brief: probe line must bind the executed command

diagnose-issue-151.evidence: Worktree at edd88e4 (main). The issue's four gaps are all present and not yet shipped. (1) templates/probe-run.cjs:195 emits `PROBE name= exit= sha= json=` with no `cmd=`; the engine PROBE_LINE regex at workflows/deliver-pipeline.js:1666 has no cmd field either. Grep for `cmd=` in templates, scripts and the workflow finds nothing relevant. (2) templates/pr-write.sh body-splice (lines ~130-142) runs a bare `gh pr edit --body-file` with no digest or stale-read check. It only restores the pre-body after a lossy post-write check, so an edit landing between read and write is overwritten. `grep stale-read` returns nothing. (3) pr-write.sh:71 reads markers with `gh "$kind" view --json comments`, which is limited to the first 100 comments. `grep paginate` returns nothing. (4) deliver-pipeline.js:1612 builds the status label with `name.split(' ').join('-')`, which only replaces spaces. SAFE_PROBE_TOKEN is `/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/` (line 1668), so any other character fails isSafeProbeToken, which is the claimed silent throw. Baseline run: `bash templates/test-probe-run.sh` exits 0 (`[probe-run] status=ok passed=92 failed=0`), with none of the new cases (cmd=, cmd-mismatch, stale-read, 101-comment thread) present. The requested feature is coherent and buildable, and depends-on is none. Lane: purely engine/backend (templates and workflow), no user-visible surface, so Sam is the right lane. I did not run a live repro of the 101-comment or race behaviour. The checks above are a baseline test run plus greps. I did not post a design-step comment, since I found no classification mismatch.
diagnose-issue-151.designStepSignalEvidence: persistentStateSignal: templates/pr-write.sh:136 rewrites the PR body via `gh pr edit` (read-modify-write on GitHub PR and issue comment state), and the issue changes the PROBE line wire format that the engine parses (one-way door per the issue). Other signals are false. No auth boundary change, no deploy config, and `gh --paginate` REST is already used in this codebase.

scout-issue-151-1.plan: GROUNDING: verified. Plan #151 (full text in .pipeline/plans/issue-151-sam.md). Steps: (1) templates/probe-run.cjs:probeLine emits cmd=<sha256(record.cmd)>. (2) workflows/deliver-pipeline.js parser markers: PROBE_LINE requires cmd=, parseProbeLine returns cmd, add sanitizeProbeToken ([^A-Za-z0-9._-] -> '-') inside the markers (R1 regex counter unchanged). (3) pure-JS sha256Hex (UTF-8, no regex) between sha256Hex:start/end markers; probe() fails closed 'cmd-mismatch' when parsed.cmd or verified.cmd != sha256Hex(cmd). (4) updateStatus uses 'status-' + sanitizeProbeToken(name). (5) templates/pr-write.sh: comment_op paginates via gh api --paginate when 100 comments are returned; body_splice_op gains --expect-digest and a re-read right before gh pr edit, returning failed/stale-read on digest change (digest = same as pr-state.sh bodyDigest). (6) Migrate ~190 PROBE/VERIFY lines in 16 fixtures with a scratch (uncommitted) script that computes cmd sha from the prompt's --cmd; update fixtures/README.md. (7) New raw fixture fixtures/incidents/151-probe-cmd-mismatch.json (expect throws cmd-mismatch). (8) templates/test-probe-run.sh: update expected line, add 7 [151] checks (cmd=, sha256 parity, stale digest, mid-write edit, 101-comment issue and PR threads, sanitiser). No new status/agent()/hook/seam. patch-avoided: engine-wired --expect-digest, run-offline cmd= injection shim, always-REST reads, optional cmd=, sanitising inside probe().

scout-issue-151-1.rationale: All four gaps confirmed on base edd88e4. The fix is the smallest change that closes each cause: cmd= in the PROBE line checked by the engine, a re-read before the PR body edit, REST pagination for marker reads, and a label sanitiser. It adds no status, agent(), hook or seam. The biggest cost is migrating the roughly 190 static fixture lines, which is mechanical. Proof log is in the artifact: baselines are green and the new checks are red on base for the stated reason.
